crossRefs.note: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

people.name: Lo-ruhamah
people.line: Symbolic name of Hosea's daughter; represents God's withdrawal of mercy

translations.web: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
translations.bsb: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.
translations.kjv: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
translations.asv: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
